name: Gmail
note: OAuth is preferred. An app password needs 2-Step Verification and is discouraged.
auth_failure_hint: Gmail app passwords need 2-Step Verification. A Workspace or admin policy may require OAuth.

name: Microsoft 365 / Outlook.com
note: OAuth2 only. IMAP is off until it is enabled for the mailbox.
auth_failure_hint: Microsoft 365 and Outlook.com require OAuth2. IMAP may be disabled until it is enabled, and an admin may need to consent.

name: iCloud
username_hint: Apple usually expects the local part of the address. If that fails, try the full address.
auth_failure_hint: iCloud needs an app-specific password. The username is usually the local part of the address.

name: Yahoo
note: Yahoo's IMAP page says to generate an app password.
auth_failure_hint: Yahoo IMAP needs an app password and the full email address.

name: Fastmail
note: An app password is required. Fastmail does not support STARTTLS on this host.
auth_failure_hint: Fastmail requires an app password and the full email address.

name: Zoho
note: Enable IMAP first. Use an app password if 2FA or SAML is on. If Zoho shows a different host for your datacenter, paste that host.
auth_failure_hint: Enable IMAP in Zoho settings. Use an app password when 2FA or SAML is on, and paste the host from Zoho if it differs.

name: GMX
note: GMX documents TLS 1.2 or 1.3. Port 143 with STARTTLS is a documented fallback; set it on the profile if 993 is blocked.
auth_failure_hint: Enable IMAP in the GMX account, then use the mailbox password.

name: Yandex
username_hint: Use the Yandex username. For @yandex.com that is the local part.
note: Enable IMAP and create an app password in the Yandex mail settings.
auth_failure_hint: Enable IMAP in Yandex and use an app password. For @yandex.com the username is the local part.

name: AWS WorkMail
note: Set host_id to the documented region, or paste the host from the WorkMail console.
auth_failure_hint: Use the full WorkMail address and the IMAP password from your administrator.
